result:
**Verdict: FAIL** for DG7 round 1 on candidate `df8225e5…f944`. I raised 3 Medium findings and 1 Low; none is Critical or High, and none is a mandatory violation. The product itself held up well on this candidate. The FAIL comes from the three Medium findings, which must be repaired before the gate. Two of them are in delivery records and release tooling, the third is a missing test.

**Candidate check:** the ID recomputed at source commit `a60a962` matches (3148 files), at the start and the end of the review. HEAD was the freeze commit `8f79401`, not the source commit, and it hashes differently (finding F-DG7-953).

**What I re-ran and what passed:**

| Area | Result |
|---|---|
| Static checks | build, typecheck, lint, OpenAPI lint (965 operations), no-CDN and prettier all exit 0 |
| Unit | 3035/3036 + 2179 + 259. Two unit-node files failed: one needed a file my sparse clone had left out, the other timed out under load. Both pass on re-run (12/12). |
| Integration (474 files) | 4686 passed, exit 0; the 8 skips and 1 todo are by design |
| Product e2e, English and Arabic | 570 passed; the 2 demo-only tests pass on the demo stack |
| Acceptance e2e A03–A22 | 288 passed + 18 axe skips by design; every outbound connection went to loopback |
| Offline drill (A02, A21) | 10/10 with outbound network blocked |
| A18 transfer | archive built from the frozen commit verifies; the harness ran the drill on it, 10/10, steps D0–D11 PASS |
| A19 restore | drill steps R1–R9 PASS; harness 13/13 |
| A27 resumption | my own re-drill at the freeze commit passes, including the "work continues from progress.md" clause that the earlier drill left partial |
| Validators | DG6 back to DG0 historical PASS; pipeline PASS |

**Findings:**
- **F-DG7-953 (Medium, owner delivery-orchestrator):** the freeze commit added D-271 to `decisions.md`, which is a candidate file. Every round-1 review therefore reads as stale, and `validate --stage DG7` can't match the candidate until D-271 is moved out of that file, or the candidate is re-frozen. I reproduced it both ways in a scratch clone.
- **F-DG7-954 (Medium, owner backend-workflow-engineer):** I applied the A26 drill's defect (business-unit edits allowed with read-only permission) to a copy of the candidate, and no test fails. The drill's regression tests were never merged. The product code itself is correct; the gap is in test coverage.
- **F-DG7-956 (Medium, owner devops-engineer):** 4 release-tool tests fail on the frozen tree, and CI runs that suite in full. The tests point at an older protocol-audit report, while `known-limitations.md` was regenerated from a newer one after the last green run. Confirmed: 46/50 as frozen, 50/50 once the file matches the report the tests use.
- **F-DG7-955 (Low, owner delivery-orchestrator):** the "Unresolved blockers" section of `progress.md` still says "None. DG0–DG3 APPROVED".

**Also unmet as frozen, already disclosed, so no new finding:**
- `validate --register DG7` fails on the 18 requirement rows still marked SPECIFIED. Changing them means editing `requirements.csv`, which is part of the candidate.
- My re-run of the protocol audit reproduces the disclosed DG7 hits. So REQ-DLV-008 (first clause), -011, -012 and -024 are literally unmet; the release-auditor decides under D-270.
- The clauses that only complete after the gate (A23 for DG7, the seal, the final report) can't be shown yet.

**Not run by me:**
- **Container half:** judged from the orchestrator's host-run evidence only, since I have no Docker access here. It ran on a pre-freeze tree whose server, worker and image definitions match the candidate's.
- **Live registry, live CI, real identity provider, external systems:** checked only on their offline/configuration surface; none is reported as a live pass.
- **`LANG=C.UTF-8` repeats:** not done, for time. Both English and Arabic Playwright projects did run.

**Deviations from the assignment:**
- I used `round: 1`, not 7, because the validator requires the round to match the directory.
- The template record it names (DG5 round-3 QA) doesn't exist, so I mirrored DG5 round 2 and DG6 round 1.
- F-DG7-953 and F-DG7-955 are owned by delivery-orchestrator, which the schema allows, because only the orchestrator writes those records.
- A validator loop I had stopped kept running and wrote logs that might show another reviewer's verdict. I moved them aside unread and re-ran that check on a clone of the freeze commit instead.

The record and sidecar both validate against their schemas, all 86 evidence paths exist, the secret scan of my evidence passes, and the disposable clones are removed.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- `reviews/DG7/round-1/qa-verifier.json`
- `reviews/DG7/round-1/qa-verifier.findings.json`
- `reviews/DG7/round-1/qa-verifier.md`
- `test-evidence/DG7/qa/round-1/` (all logs and drill outputs)
